items.exampleEn: Her desk is always clean and neat.
items.exampleZh: 她的桌子總是乾淨又整齊。

items.exampleEn: Your passport must be valid for at least six months.
items.exampleZh: 你的護照效期必須還有至少六個月。

items.exampleEn: The camera came with a thick manual in five languages.
items.exampleZh: 這台相機附了一本有五種語言的厚手冊。

items.exampleEn: A good location is highly desirable for a new shop.
items.exampleZh: 對新店來說，好地點是非常理想的條件。

items.exampleEn: There is a small flaw in the glass.
items.exampleZh: 這塊玻璃上有一個小瑕疵。

items.exampleEn: Please wrap these two gifts separately.
items.exampleZh: 請把這兩份禮物分開包裝。

items.exampleEn: Moving abroad means getting used to unfamiliar food and customs.
items.exampleZh: 搬到國外，就得習慣不熟悉的食物和習俗。

items.exampleEn: She has exceptional skills in design.
items.exampleZh: 她在設計方面有卓越的能力。

items.sentenceEn: The two documents must be signed and sent separately.
items.sentenceZh: 這兩份文件必須分別簽名、分別寄出。

items.audioEn: Sorry, this gift card is no longer valid. It ended last week.
items.audioZh: 抱歉，這張禮物卡已經失效了，上週就到期了。
items.questionZh: 這張禮物卡為什麼不能用？

items.sentenceEn: The car looks perfect, but it has one serious flaw.
items.sentenceZh: 這台車看起來很完美，但有一個嚴重的缺陷。

items.sentenceEn: This camera is manual, so you need to focus it yourself.
items.sentenceZh: 這台相機是手動的，你得自己對焦。

items.stemEn: The software was ____ to me, so I asked a colleague for help.
items.stemZh: 我對這套軟體不熟悉，所以請同事幫忙。

items.stemEn: Please keep your room ____ and clean while guests are staying with us.
items.stemZh: 客人住在我們家的期間，請保持你的房間整齊乾淨。

items.passageEn: Last month, I looked for an apartment in an unfamiliar part of the city. The first one looked neat and modern, but I soon found a serious flaw: the windows did not close properly. The second had an exceptional view of the river, which made it highly desirable, so the price was too high. The third was perfect, and the rent was affordable. The owner gave me a thick manual that explained how to use the heating and the washing machine. Before I signed, he asked to see a valid ID card, and he wanted me to pay the rent and the deposit separately. I moved in last weekend, and I love it.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我在城裡一個不熟悉的地區找公寓。第一間看起來整齊又現代，但我很快就發現一個嚴重的缺點：窗戶關不好。第二間能看到絕佳的河景，非常搶手，所以價格太高。第三間就很完美，房租也負擔得起。屋主給了我一本厚厚的手冊，說明暖氣和洗衣機怎麼用。簽約前，他要求看我的有效身分證件，還要我把房租和押金分開付。我上週末搬進去了，我很喜歡。

questions.questionZh: 第一間公寓有什麼缺點？
屋主在簽約前要求作者做什麼？
options: 先把整個房間打掃乾淨
先一次付清一整年的房租

referenceEn: This ticket is only valid today.
This ticket is valid for today only.
rubricZh: valid 當形容詞，表示「有效的」（例如 is valid today、valid for today only）
only 的位置可以變化（例如 only valid today、valid only today、valid for today only）

items.instructionZh: 用 exceptional 造一個句子，稱讚你認識的人或你去過的地方。
referenceEn: My English teacher is an exceptional speaker.
I stayed at a hotel with exceptional service in Tainan.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 exceptional，表示「卓越的、出色的」（例如 exceptional service、an exceptional speaker）
句意要是稱讚某人或某地特別好

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：疑似寫死位置：「only 放在 valid 前或 today 後都可以」未涵蓋 "valid only today"、"valid only for today" 等同樣正確的位置，建議改「例如 only valid today、valid for today only」。
